g.text: Replay authority charge sizes for one publication (DR-79)
native session driver runs one intent at a time
(every intent carries footprint key [2, 0], so each frontier is one component)
identity lookups in pending_stack_event_ids, pending_replay_events, events
only when the allocation is enforced: the dominance scan,
Every charge is reserved before the first mutation.
No .await separates prepare from publish, and the driver
runs no other intent and no participant in between.
granted COMM with a debit of
validate, add the debit to R, insert into P
remove from P, add the debit to Z,
insert into E (or into F for a denied COMM)
remove from P, subtract the debit from R
each search ran on a map no larger than its charged size
S = pending stack identities, P = pending replay events, E = events,
F = frontier, R = reserved, Z = realized, A = allocation, k = debit lanes.
Pre-operation sizes and one bound on summed sizes undercharge
